svg.title: Osmium-catalyzed syn dihydroxylation: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Reduced osmium species + NMO → OsO4 + N-methylmorpholine-derived products. Co-oxidant regenerates active osmium; the redox/ligand network is grouped rather than assigned a fictitious closed-shell elementary code.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
